name: Accot-Zhai Steering Law
axiom: Steering time through a tunnel grows with its length and shrinks with its width.
trigger: A cursor entering a nested fly-out drifts a few pixels sideways and the menu collapses.

checklist.text: Replace narrow nested fly-outs with a flat mega-menu or a wide hover corridor.
Add a triangular safe-hover zone between the pointer and the open submenu.
Keep generous padding on drag tracks, sliders, and scrollbar thumbs.

antiPattern.violation: A desktop menu makes the pointer cross a fourteen-pixel submenu path, and one pixel outside closes it.
antiPattern.remediation: An invisible hit polygon joins the pointer to the open submenu, so a diagonal move keeps it open.

parametricParams.caption: STEERING TIME RISES AS THE TUNNEL NARROWS

academicOrigin.title: Beyond Fitts' Law: Models for Trajectory-Based HCI Tasks
